recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3973; future work should address only independently filed Procedure.category issues rather than reapplying the DSTU1 addition.
issue_request: FHIR-3973 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1, asking to add a Procedure category code so systems could filter procedures such as chiro/physio, counseling, education, surgery, and diagnostic procedures even when they cannot infer that grouping from the procedure code.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit a3ff66ac14ef468c12044f8701ee752d60d3c736, matching Jira's svn revision 4819 comment. That commit added Procedure.category to the Procedure spreadsheet and created the procedure-category value set with SNOMED CT concepts for psychiatry/service, counseling, education, surgical procedure, diagnostic procedure, and chiropractic manipulation.
additional_context: Procedure is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The modern generated StructureDefinition source still includes Procedure.category as 0..* CodeableConcept, summary=true, with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-category. Later related decisions refined the same area: FHIR-7123 clarified the category/code distinction, FHIR-8984 added a category search parameter, FHIR-20628 changed Procedure.category from 0..1 to 0..*, and FHIR-42739 replaced an inactive diagnostic SNOMED CT concept with current laboratory, imaging, and measurement procedure concepts.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already preserves the requested category element and example value set, and later source history has appropriately evolved cardinality, search, and value set contents without contradicting FHIR-3973.

related_jiras.note: Resolved no-change because the category field already had a value set with codes after FHIR-3973.

Changed Procedure.category cardinality to 0..* and is already represented on the combined branch.
Updated the procedure-category example value set for inactive SNOMED CT content and is already represented on the combined branch.
